name: cdp
description: a drug program's clinical development plan (CDP) slide deck. Give at most one record per indication: the one that best answers the field. Include a record only when the file states its value. When a date or status is stated for the program/asset as a whole rather than for one indication, give one record with indication null

fields.workbook_input: Input Fields 20261110.xlsm / Takeda Asset Inputs row 8: Indications (asset level; required)
fields.description: Every indication in scope for the asset -- lead and follow-on, one per entry, with population qualifiers as written (e.g. severity, line of therapy, age group).

fields.workbook_input: Input Fields 20261110.xlsm / Takeda Asset Inputs row 5: Phase of Development (per indication; required; options Pre-clinical, Phase I, Phase II, Phase II/III, Phase III)
fields.description: The CURRENT development phase of each indication. Prefer a phase the file states as current for the indication. Otherwise a CDP usually states phases per study (e.g. a studies table: 'Study X | Phase 3 | Indication Y | first patient Q2 2028'): the phase of a study counts for the indication it studies, but only studies that are ongoing or completed -- not ones still planned for the future (use start dates and labels such as 'planned', 'ongoing', 'completed'); when several qualify, give the most advanced and cite that study's row. If the file doesn't make clear which studies have started, give the earliest-starting study's phase and cite that row.
Primary key: the indication this record is about, matched by code to the indications list, or null for the whole program (this text is not sent).

The phase as written (e.g. 'Phase 2b', 'Ph3', 'Pre-clinical', 'seamless Phase 2/3', 'Launched'). Category: Phase 1/1a/1b -> Phase I, Phase 2/2a/2b -> Phase II, Phase 2/3, 2b/3 or a seamless/adaptive phase 2-3 study -> Phase II/III, Phase 3/3b -> Phase III, pre-clinical/IND-enabling -> Pre-clinical. An indication already approved, marketed or launched has no category: leave option null and keep the wording in value.

fields.workbook_input: Input Fields 20261110.xlsm / Takeda Asset Inputs row 48: US FDA Submission Timing (per indication; optional; year and month)
fields.description: The expected US regulatory submission date of each indication: the NDA or BLA filing/submission to the FDA (also 'US filing', 'sNDA/sBLA submission', 'rolling submission complete'). Only submission dates: a US approval, PDUFA or launch date belongs to us_fda_approval_timing or us_launch_timing, not here; if the file gives no US submission date for an indication, give no record for it.
Primary key: the indication this record is about, matched by code to the indications list, or null for the whole program (this text is not sent).
What the date is for, as written: e.g. 'NDA submission', 'BLA filing', 'sBLA submission', 'US filing'.
The date as written (e.g. 'Mar 2031', 'Q4 2030', '2H 2029').

fields.workbook_input: Input Fields 20261110.xlsm / Takeda Asset Inputs row 50: US FDA Approval Timing (per indication; required; year and month)
fields.description: The expected US FDA approval date of each indication: 'FDA approval', 'US approval', 'PDUFA date' or 'action date' (a PDUFA/action date is the expected approval date). Only approval dates: a submission/filing date belongs to us_fda_submission_timing and a launch date to us_launch_timing, not here; if the file gives no US approval date for an indication, give no record for it.
Primary key: the indication this record is about, matched by code to the indications list, or null for the whole program (this text is not sent).
What the date is for, as written: e.g. 'FDA approval', 'US approval', 'PDUFA'.
The date as written (e.g. 'Mar 2031', 'Q4 2030', '2H 2029').

fields.workbook_input: Input Fields 20261110.xlsm / Takeda Asset Inputs row 52: US Launch Timing (per indication; optional; year and month)
fields.description: The expected US launch date of each indication: 'US launch', 'first launch (US)', 'commercial launch US', 'US availability'. Only launch dates: a submission/filing date belongs to us_fda_submission_timing and an approval or PDUFA date to us_fda_approval_timing, not here; if the file gives no US launch date for an indication, give no record for it.
Primary key: the indication this record is about, matched by code to the indications list, or null for the whole program (this text is not sent).
What the date is for, as written: e.g. 'US launch', '1st launch (US)', 'commercial launch'.
The date as written (e.g. 'Mar 2031', 'Q4 2030', '2H 2029').

fields.workbook_input: Input Fields 20261110.xlsm / Takeda Asset Inputs row 49: EU MAA Submission Timing (per indication; required; year and month; 'clarify whether the product will pursue an MAA in the EU and, if so, the assumed submission timing')
fields.description: Whether an EU Marketing Authorisation Application (MAA, the EMA submission) is planned for each indication and when it is to be submitted. Only the MAA submission: an EU approval, CHMP opinion or EU launch date belongs to eu_ema_approval_timing or eu_launch_timing, not here. Give a record when the file states a submission date, or states that no EU MAA is planned.
Primary key: the indication this record is about, matched by code to the indications list, or null for the whole program (this text is not sent).
Whether an EU MAA is planned, as the file states it (e.g. 'EU MAA', 'MAA submission', 'not planned', 'EU not in scope').
The planned MAA submission date as written (e.g. 'Q1 2031', 'Mar 2031'); null if not pursuing or no date is stated.

fields.workbook_input: Input Fields 20261110.xlsm / Takeda Asset Inputs row 51: EU EMA Approval Timing (per indication; required; year)
fields.description: The expected EU regulatory approval date of each indication: 'EC approval', 'EMA approval', 'EU approval', or the 'CHMP opinion' if that is the only EU approval milestone given (say so in milestone). Only approval dates: the MAA submission date belongs to eu_maa_submission_timing and an EU launch date to eu_launch_timing, not here; if the file gives no EU approval date for an indication, give no record for it.
Primary key: the indication this record is about, matched by code to the indications list, or null for the whole program (this text is not sent).
What the date is for, as written: e.g. 'EC approval', 'EU approval', 'CHMP opinion'.
The date as written (e.g. 'H2 2031', '2032', 'Q1 2033').

fields.workbook_input: Input Fields 20261110.xlsm / Takeda Asset Inputs row 53: EU Launch Timing (per indication; optional; year)
fields.description: The expected EU launch date of each indication: 'EU launch', 'first EU launch', 'launch (EU5)', 'EU availability'. Only launch dates: the MAA submission belongs to eu_maa_submission_timing and an EU approval or CHMP date to eu_ema_approval_timing, not here; if the file gives no EU launch date for an indication, give no record for it.
Primary key: the indication this record is about, matched by code to the indications list, or null for the whole program (this text is not sent).
What the date is for, as written: e.g. 'EU launch', 'first launch (Germany)', 'EU5 launch'.
The date as written (e.g. 'H2 2031', '2032', 'Q1 2033').

fields.workbook_input: Input Fields 20261110.xlsm / Takeda Asset Inputs row 10: Mode of Administration & Medicare Coverage (asset level; required; options Inpatient (Medicare Part B), Outpatient, HCP-administered (Medicare Part B), Outpatient, patient-administered (Medicare Part D))
fields.description: How the product is administered and in what setting, which decides its expected US Medicare coverage: usually stated once for the product (route, formulation, dosing: e.g. 'oral once daily', 'IV infusion every 3 weeks', 'SC injection, self-administered', 'autologous cell therapy infused in hospital'). Give one record with indication null when the file states it for the product as a whole; per indication only when the route or setting differs between indications. Category: administered during a hospital admission (e.g. a CAR-T or gene therapy infusion with inpatient monitoring, surgery) -> Inpatient (Medicare Part B); an infusion or injection given by a healthcare professional in a clinic, infusion centre or physician's office -> Outpatient, HCP-administered (Medicare Part B); an oral, inhaled, topical or self-injected product the patient takes at home -> Outpatient, patient-administered (Medicare Part D). Leave option null when the file gives the route but not enough to tell the setting (e.g. 'SC injection' without saying who administers it).
Primary key: the indication this record is about, matched by code to the indications list, or null for the whole program (this text is not sent).
The route, formulation, dosing schedule and setting as written (e.g. 'oral tablet once daily', 'IV infusion q3w in the outpatient clinic', 'single inpatient infusion').
